_comment: Single source of truth for every worker. Geometry (batch, blockThreads, minBlocks, workers) must match the binary named by binaryKey and must never change while checkpoints exist: a checkpoint is only loadable into the same worker/batch shape. 16 slots over 385,024 workers is the audited RTX PRO 6000 preset and the 6,160,384 logical walks it measured at 14.1 B iterations/s. dpWeight must be identical campaign-wide or cross-worker collisions can be missed. build.sh fills in binaryKey/hostBinaryKey/sourceSha256.
